checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=34 breakdowns=6 bursts_in_base=4 giveback=2.69 tightness=0.97 base_volume_vs_leg=1.78 base_volume_vs_avg=1.04
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 34 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; 6 4% breakdowns inside the base; the base gave back 2.69 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 19.1% vs its 20-SMA, 29.7% over 20 sessions
gain of 18.15% is 15% or more: the worst cell in the only event study, a 36% win rate and -9.3% at 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 0 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The C check is a hard FAIL with 34 sessions (nearly double the 20-session maximum), 6 breakdowns inside the base, and a giveback of 2.69 against a 0.34 threshold — the base is visibly a multi-month declining channel from August through October, not a tight consolidation. The chart confirms wide, overlapping bars across the entire shaded region with repeated 4%+ down days, and the base itself slopes downward rather than holding flat. On top of that, the burst bar is an 18.15% gain which sits in the worst event-study cell (36% win rate, -9.3% at 20 sessions), and prior breakouts in this name went 0 for 4.
claude.key_risk: The base is a prolonged downtrend with six breakdowns and massive giveback, meaning the burst is more likely a dead-cat bounce than a momentum burst from a tight consolidation.
claude.entry_note: Skip at the open if the stock gaps up further above the burst close of $3.06 or shows any fade in the first 30 minutes, given the deeply failed base and poor prior-breakout track record.
